label: Cursor chat (template)
description: Cursor Glass chat is not exposed to AT-SPI on native Wayland. Prefer koru autopilot plugin; use map+vision as fallback.
build_example: vdisplay map build --monitor DP-1 --crop-bounds x,y,w,h -o maps/cursor-chat.json
prompt_example: vdisplay ide prompt --ide cursor --map maps/cursor-chat.json --text "Summarize this file"
